Evidence Inspector & Epistemic Separation (Stage 3 — Verify)
Epistemic Notice: A citation shows where a claim came from; it does not
prove the claim is true. Approval Status is independent of Evidence Status.
1. Direct Source Statement (Verbatim from Span):
"Switched crucible setup from bare alumina to MgO crucibles with a generous
mother-powder bed after observing Al-diffusion grain boundary blocking..."
2. AI Summary / Proposed Inference (Clearly Separated):
[AI_PROPOSED · heuristic-span-reconstructor-v2]: Standardized MgO crucible
protocol raised relative density from 88.4% to 94.2% (0.68 mS/cm).
3. Canonical Evidence States & Citation Flagging:
• SUPPORTED : Linked span(s) resolve & directly support statement
• CONFLICTING : Credible linked sources disagree (both shown)
• STALE : Outdated relative to newer dated calibration source
• UNSUPPORTED : No supporting span or all citations flagged invalid
• NEEDS REVIEW : Plausible link requiring human interpretation
• NOT ESTABLISHED : Open question, risk, or missing source owner/date
[Action: Flag Incorrect Citation] -> Downgrades SUPPORTED to NEEDS REVIEW
